name: se
description: Refine ideas, create feature specs with actionable tasks, save to GitHub or Markdown, and deliver reviewed changes.

interface.shortDescription: Specify features, plan tasks, and deliver reviewed changes.
interface.longDescription: SE supports repository-grounded refinement, read-only study, feature specifications, and reviewed delivery. Spec creates one coherent spec with an ordered actionable task plan, preserves accepted technical decisions, and saves to GitHub as a parent plus task issues or to one Markdown file. Delivery Features maps saved task contracts into independently reviewed PRs, verifies the combined feature outcome, and supplies precise issue-closing references. Learn maintains durable project knowledge; Idea captures tentative proposals; Implement handles selected local work; Audit observes active SE workflows. Delivery keeps claims, exact candidate and hosted review gates, and verified release before completion; merge, deploy, and release remain separately authorized.
defaultPrompt: Use $se:grilling to sharpen a topic, $se:study to investigate it, or $se:learn to preserve knowledge.
Use $se:spec to create a feature spec and actionable tasks, saving to GitHub or one Markdown file.
Use $se:adversarial-review for pressure-testing, $se:deliver-features for PRs, or $se:implement for local work.
